summary: DNR camping page + campground map read: 32 sites (11 electric), showers, flush toilets, water, dump; early April to the third weekend of October (2027 close Oct 17); reservable with first-come on unreserved sites. Not waterfront (loop in woods, no water within ~250 m). Pin at the loop's south entrance, ~170 m from its centre (keep). GTC fees/amps/lengths unread.
